channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: 🎄 Last Club Night Before Christmas at Claremont 🎄
item.description: Join us for the final Club Night of 2024 at Claremont. Enjoy exciting matches, open courts, and celebrate with friends.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Nights at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for Wednesday Club Nights at Claremont Stadium for exciting badminton matches and fun activities.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for Thursday Club Night at Claremont Stadium for an evening of badminton and camaraderie. Watch Navan face Dundalk in an exciting match or enjoy playing on the available court.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 5 Fixtures Announcement
item.description: Check out the lineup for Week 5 with 6 exciting matches, including 4 home games and 2 away games. Note the changes to club night schedule.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 3 Fixtures: Spooky Week
item.description: Get ready for 4 exciting matches this spooky week with games both home and away. Check out the schedule and join us on the court!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us at Claremont Stadium Tonight!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for a fun-filled evening of badminton. Open courts from 8pm to 11pm, with a special Juvenile Club Night starting at 6:30pm for ages 14+.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Beginner Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us tonight from 9pm to 11pm at Claremont Stadium for Beginner Club Night. Whether you're new to badminton or need some practice, we'll have you rallying quickly. All 4 courts are open for a fun-filled evening!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us tonight from 8pm to 11pm at Claremont Stadium for Wednesday Club Night. Whether you're great at badminton or just starting, we’ve got a court for you. Everyone’s welcome!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Club Night
item.description: Join us tonight from 8pm to 11pm at Claremont Stadium. All skill levels are welcome; we have 4 courts ready for you!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
